coinbase.schema_measured: payload = {channel, timestamp (exchange, ns ISO-8601), sequence_num (int, per-connection), events[]}; market_trades events carry trade_id (per-product int), time (exchange), price, size, side; l2_data events carry product_id + updates[] each with event_time, price_level, new_quantity, side

deribit.schema_measured: JSON-RPC 2.0; payload.params.data = {timestamp (ms epoch), type:'snapshot'|'change', change_id (per-instrument int), instrument_name, bids/asks [[action,price,qty],...]}; ticker data adds best_bid/ask_price+amount, mark_price, index_price, current_funding, funding_8h, open_interest; rpc_response carries usIn/usOut/usDiff

4_sequence_semantics_per_venue.coinbase: payload.sequence_num: per-connection monotone counter across ALL channels, starts at 0 (measured 0,1,2,3,...,8). Resets on reconnect -> sequence epochs are (connection_epoch, sequence_num). Cross-reconnect continuity is checked instead on per-product market_trades trade_id (monotone per product; measured 1093565225...)
4_sequence_semantics_per_venue.kraken: book feed: per (product_id, side) seq, consecutive increments expected (measured seq 296370912); trade feed: per-product seq (measured 595016) with non-monotone UUID uid (uid is an identity, NOT an ordering key); ticker: no sequence number — time (ms) only
4_sequence_semantics_per_venue.deribit: book channel: change_id per instrument, consecutive increments expected (measured ETH 135083969957 -> 135084001413, BTC 174318940803 -> 174318969050; collector already surfaces it in the seq envelope field); ticker: no sequence — timestamp (ms) only
4_sequence_semantics_per_venue.consequence: gap detection is venue-specific (see field 5); venues without full sequencing (tickers) are NEVER claimed complete — their bars inherit validity from the sequenced channels of the same venue

5_reconnect_and_gap_policy.principle: fail-loud, gap-marked, never silent; Deribit measured 1 disconnect in a 21.5s census window — reconnects are ROUTINE and must be engineered for, not treated as exceptional
on_gap: detect: CB sequence_num delta > 1 across consecutive messages; KR book seq delta > 1 per (product, side); KR trade seq delta > 1 per product; DB change_id delta != 1 per instrument
record: append an explicit gap record line {type:'gap', venue, channel, instrument, from_seq, to_seq, missing_count, first_recv_utc} to the raw shard — the gap is DATA, never dropped

recover: immediately re-subscribe and take a fresh venue snapshot (CB re-subscribe; KR new book/trade_snapshot; DB new book snapshot with type:'snapshot'); never interpolate, never reuse a stale snapshot
invalidate: any derived H1 bar whose inputs span a gap interval is marked invalid_gapped in the derived panel with the gap record ids attached
on_disconnect: exponential backoff reconnect (1s, 2s, 4s, ... capped 60s), new connection_epoch assigned, snapshot taken before deltas resume
connection_epoch boundaries recorded in shard manifest; no cross-epoch sequence stitching anywhere in derivations
5_reconnect_and_gap_policy.silent_data_never: a message that fails parse/schema is written raw to a shard-rejected subrecord with reason; nothing is dropped unlogged

6_heartbeat_policy.coinbase: subscribe heartbeats channel (measured ~1 Hz, 239 msgs/238s); absence > 15s -> probe then reconnect
6_heartbeat_policy.kraken: subscribe heartbeat feed (measured ~10s cadence, 25 msgs/236s); absence > 60s -> reconnect
6_heartbeat_policy.deribit: public/set_heartbeat 30s + test_request on silence (measured 1 rpc_heartbeat at connect+10s in the truncated census window); absence > 45s -> reconnect
6_heartbeat_policy.local_watchdog: per-venue wall-clock watchdog + TCP keepalive; heartbeat events counted per shard in the manifest so liveness is auditable

7_raw_byte_hashing_and_manifest_conventi.shard_rule: one shard per (venue, UTC day, connection_epoch); written append-only via temp+atomic rename; a closed shard is NEVER rewritten (any post-close defect = new correction shard + incident record)

8_duplicate_and_out_of_order_policy.duplicates: raw capture is verbatim and NEVER deduplicated; derivation-level dedupe key = (venue, connection_epoch, venue sequence/trade id, sha256 of raw line); duplicates counted per shard (dup_count) and dropped only at derivation, never silently (dedupe counts land in derived-panel metadata)
8_duplicate_and_out_of_order_policy.out_of_order: raw lines are kept in arrival (recv_utc) order, never reordered; derived bars assign events by EXCHANGE event timestamp within [bar_start - 300s, bar_close + 10s close-delay]; events later than the close-delay are counted late_late_count and excluded from that bar (they are preserved raw, never backfilled into an older bar)
8_duplicate_and_out_of_order_policy.snapshot_descending_note: trade snapshots arrive newest-first (measured Coinbase trade_id descending in snapshot) — descending order inside a snapshot is NOT out-of-order; ordering keys are per-product exchange ids, not arrival order

12_preregistered_regime_definitions.vol_regime_estimator: for each prospective H1 bar t: r_t = ln(median cross-venue mid_t / median cross-venue mid_{t-1}) on the instrument's asset (BTC instruments: CB BTC-USD / KR PF_XBTUSD / DB BTC-PERPETUAL; ETH likewise); RV24(t) = sqrt(sum of r_i^2 over the trailing 24 bars) — the same estimand as the S4 daily RV (24h sum of hourly squared log returns), computable every H1 bar
